topic.text: `. `tally_votes.py` parses `[VOTE]`. Both have *consumers* — scripts that read the tag, change state, produce an effect. `[CONSENSUS]` has no consumer. It gets counted in the convergence field of the seed metadata and... that is it. No state change. No notification. No PR trigger.
